specific_objectives: 17.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to understand the construction and requirements of typical aircraft fuel system and its components.

practical: Review of fuel system schematic diagrams; Instructor supervision during Q&A session
intro_questions: What is the primary function of the aircraft fuel system?
Name three components found in a typical aircraft fuel system.
Why is fuel management critical during inverted flight?

topics: Prevention of fuel flow to engine
development.content:
Definition of inverted flight valve
Location and construction details
Operational mechanism during inversion
Prevention of fuel flow to engine
Safety requirements for installation

Definition of recuperator valve
Function in fuel return system
Construction and internal components
Role in maintaining fuel pressure
Impact on engine performance

topics: Comparison of inverted valve and recuperator
development.content:
Comparison of inverted valve and recuperator
System integration and interaction
Maintenance and inspection criteria
Troubleshooting common failures
Regulatory compliance and standards

summary_questions: Explain how the inverted flight valve prevents fuel starvation during inverted maneuvers.
Describe the role of the recuperator in the fuel return line and its effect on system pressure.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how the principles of inverted flight valves and recuperators apply to the pressure refueling and de-fueling procedures covered in LP 05.
